Follows Claude Code 2.1.309: quoting into a draft now puts the quote above what you were writing and keeps your caret where it was.

- `❝ quote` and `/desk-quote` with a draft in the prompt: the quote goes on top (after any quotes you added earlier), and the caret stays where you were typing, instead of the quote being appended at the end and the caret jumping there. An empty prompt works as before
- Uses the new `cursor` argument of `$.prompt.fill`
- Needs Claude Code 2.1.309 or later

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
